stem:
Varun feels cooler after sweating during a games period, and his grandmother sprinkles water on the terrace roof on a hot day.

Why can evaporation make skin or a roof feel cooler?

options.text: As liquid water evaporates, it takes heat from the skin or roof, so those surfaces feel cooler.
Water vapour condenses into sweat on the skin, and that condensation cools the skin.
Water at the same temperature as the roof cools the roof just by wetting it, even if none evaporates.
Sweat evaporates because the skin has already become cooler.

teacher.key_rationale: Evaporation takes heat from the skin or roof, so those surfaces feel cooler.
